paragraphs: Ifa recited Shevuot at Rabbah’s academy (see Rav Acha bar Rav Huna). His brother Avimi met him, Shevuot 28b. Rashi: sons of Rachava of Pumbedita (see Ilfa). Jerusalem Talmud, Nedarim, chapter 2, and Shevuot, chapter 3: Chifa asked his brother Avimi. They are the sharp scholars of Pumbedita (see there). He asked Rabbi Yehudah, Pe'ah, chapter 7, halakhah 6.
